checks.Name: programmatic_move
checks.Detail: Physical position 50,125 -> 90,155. Mouse dragging is a separate manual check.

checks.Name: toolbar_move_follows_frame
checks.Detail: Frame 120,175 900x400; toolbar 120,100 900x75. Exercises the same position coupling used by DragMove.

checks.Name: resize_corner_hit_test
checks.Detail: WM_NCHITTEST at bottom-right returned 17; expected HTBOTTOMRIGHT (17).

checks.Name: topmost_styles
checks.Detail: Frame and toolbar have WS_EX_TOPMOST and were placed above a temporary topmost diagnostic background.

checks.Name: capture_affinity
checks.Detail: Both frame and toolbar must report WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE; actual pixels are tested below.

checks.Name: background_capture_allowed
checks.Detail: The background runs in a separate process and has no capture exclusion.

checks.Name: toolbar_remains_interactive
checks.Detail: Toolbar WS_EX_TRANSPARENT=False; hit HWND=10DFA, toolbar HWND=10DFA.

checks.Name: capture_shows_underlying_pixels
checks.Detail: Center sample must match synthetic background RGB 24,74,99 despite the opaque magenta overlay.

checks.Name: overlay_excluded_from_capture
checks.Detail: Before/after changed pixels=0; magenta pixels=0. The marker is visible in the separate WPF preview.

checks.Name: unlock_restores_interaction
checks.Detail: Unlock removes WS_EX_TRANSPARENT and restores ResizeMode.CanResize.

limitations: Programmatic native-window checks; no physical mouse input was synthesized.
Browser, PDF, borderless game, and mixed-monitor/scaling interaction require separate live checks.
frame-render-preview.png is a labeled WPF render composite. capture-*.png are actual ScreenCapturer output.
